summary: črk duplicates the variant entry črg.
rationale: Both entries have the same Turkish etymon çürük, identical German sense, and the same example 'qəṣle u=qŭmāš b-ġalṭo w ...' at grammar page 228. Only g/k varies in the root, base forms and cited verb. Consolidate these variant spellings as one verb while retaining the variant information.
